Treat these as directional planning ranges, not a base-case forecast. Related: Bitcoin: ETF Inflows Reach $3.5 Billion in August - blockchain.news (Google News (crypto ETF)).
  • Listed ETF flows remain the cleanest demand gauge: Net flow prints often lead AUM changes, so listed-channel demand shows up in the KPI strip before long-run fund-table balances fully reset. Related: BlackRock's IBIT Captures 95% of $216.7 Million Bitcoin ETF Inflow Rebound - finance.biggo.com (Google News (crypto ETF)).

Filing volume does not mean all products launch or scale, but it does point to a heavier near-term slate of spot and spot-adjacent product attempts.
